description: Send your person a spoken message through their agent. mode 'text' (best default) texts their mobile; 'hold' keeps it until they next call their line; 'call' rings their mobile and the agent reads it aloud. Their reply by text lands in my_messages. Use 'call' only when they asked to be rung, or for something that can't wait. Calls spend credits.
name: tell_me
title: Leave word for my person
